_comment: Copy to dynamic-config.json (gitignored), replace values with your authorized isolated TEST fixture, then websec dynamic --config dynamic-config.json --facts websec-out/latest/FACTS.json. Missing/mismatched controls leave results inconclusive.
_controls_comment: Provision distinct private records owned by each test identity. The identity endpoint must return the declared identity; each owner read must expose its marker and anonymous reads must deny access. Supply the actual deployed application/build identity. Empty bodies or status differences alone do not confirm a vulnerability.
